US Capitol Dome Sunrise Washington DC Portrait / WASHINGTON D.C., United States — The US Capitol dome rises in silhouette against a wide sunrise sky, the sun aligned directly behind the drum in this portrait-format frame from Capitol Hill. Architect Thomas U. Walter designed the current cast-iron structure in the 1850s to replace a masonry dome that had topped the building since the early 19th century Stock Photo - Alamy
   Citation ID: 10b1
   URL: https://www.alamy.com/us-capitol-dome-sunrise-washington-dc-portrait-washington-dc-united-image62056107.html

3. US Capitol Dome Silhouette Sunrise Skyline Washington DC / WASHINGTON D.C., United States — The U.S. Capitol dome silhouettes against a pre-dawn sky streaked with orange and blue, a construction crane rising to the left in this wider-framed companion to the sunrise sequence. The dome itself is a double-shell cast-iron structure, a technology that allowed engineers Thomas U. Walter and Montgomery C. Meigs to add nearly 9 million pounds (4,000 metric tons) of iron above the existing masonry walls without overloading them Stock Photo - Alamy
